author: bounded_idea_supply
scope: Two existing mechanically different approaches reviewed during root's GDT1238 work. No new source or manuscript material, implementation, counts, lexical assignments or root-owned file edits.
retrieval_limit: Bounded idea searches and primary reads were used. A subsequent ideas show encountered the parent's stale index snapshot; no refresh was attempted. This is not a complete backlog audit or proof that no other candidate exists.

candidates.human_mechanism: A learned syllabic lexicon with explicit compositional controls, literal-name spelling and paid line continuation.
candidates.positive_preserved: The source-held manual reading recovered both complete teaching clauses, their roles and scope, literal names and continuation.
candidates.selection: Do not nominate the unchanged writer or a selector-only repair. The later review excludes every reassignment of its eight functions while retaining q/o framing: an eligible repeated predicate cannot supply its own required nominal argument.
candidates.limit: This does not exclude all global 22-glyph renamings or all syllabaries. A mere untested global font remapping is nevertheless not a new human writing mechanism or sufficient reason to reopen this contract.

candidates.human_mechanism: Write a procedure body once, then call it with explicit parameters; distinguish reuse of that procedure from reference to a previously produced result.
candidates.positive_preserved: P26 already authored a fixed two-parameter expansion and retained incomplete calls, repeated processing of the same portion, and a conditional downstream state contrast. This is substantive prior work, not an unexecuted idea merely because a registry import is unreviewed.
candidates.decisive_constraint: Changing procedure input versus reusing an old product can change content, but the distinction has already been authored. A newly invented teaching example would only demonstrate the supplied semantics again. An independently constrained consumer or reference consequence is required before this becomes a new manuscript discriminator.
candidates.selection: No new macro card or hand-readback test. The existing entries do not supply a distinct paid full physical writer with an unresolved selection consequence. Their freely hypothesized native meanings remain unassigned historical hypotheses.

decision: No new RAW card and no next experiment selected from these two candidates. Preserve the positive teaching evidence and the precise later limitations; do not interpret this bounded stop as exhaustion of the raw supply.
